answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch commitment and evaluate its polynomial at a beacon-derived identity point, with Semaphore proofs binding each message to a nullifier. A second message beyond the rate limit exposes two inconsistent shares; Shamir reconstruction reveals the private key, allowing validators to verify the violation and instantly slash collateral. The public commitment acts as a pigment marking accountable identities, while the ripple of a duplicate proof makes Sybil abuse costly rather than anonymous.
